blocks.html: Viewing panels shall be provided in solid fences erected on or after July 1, 2013, at a rate one for every 25 linear feet (7.6 m) per frontage, with a minimum of one per frontage. Viewing panels shall be 12" x 12" (305 x 305 mm) in size and shall be blocked with nonfrangible acrylic paneling or equivalent material. The top of the viewing panel shall be located no more than 6 feet (1829 mm) above the level of the ground, and the bottom of the viewing panel shall be located no less than 3 feet (914 mm) above the level of the ground.
